title: Example Foreign Issuer Ltd. F-1/A primary offering amendment
primaryDocumentText:
FORM F-1/A
Amendment No. 2 to Registration Statement
Registration No. 333-123456
Example Foreign Issuer Ltd.
(Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter)

PROSPECTUS SUMMARY
This amendment updates the number of ordinary shares offered, the assumed offering price, and the underwriting terms.

THE OFFERING
We are offering 2,500,000 ordinary shares at an assumed public offering price of $3.50 per ordinary share. The gross proceeds from this offering are expected to be $8.75 million and net proceeds are expected to be approximately $7.9 million.

USE OF PROCEEDS
We intend to use the net proceeds for sales expansion, repayment of short-term borrowings, and working capital.

DILUTION
Investors in this offering will experience immediate dilution in adjusted net tangible book value.

RISK FACTORS
We have incurred losses and may need additional capital after this offering.

UNDERWRITING
Prime Number Capital LLC is acting as representative of the underwriters. The closing is expected to occur on July 2, 2026.

DESCRIPTION OF SECURITIES
The offering does not include warrants or convertible securities.
